Recorded by the project's decision thread. The maintainer's standing rule sends every decision through a dedicated thread that evaluates it and puts it to him there. He chose at 2026-11-16T13:34:26Z. Decision thread `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X2H6qQ8ciHX7XMq2gtnGnNg`, card `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XUxdm8VeU5D1w4Lp1c7zvNe`, choice record `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XWytyBwbs22Nf9pBEDQt9fK`.

Thread-read: 6905085689 (the triage first touch, the only comment). Labels at the read: `bug`, `priority:p2`, `pm:queue`, `domain:server`, unassigned.

## The question he was asked

His intake rule of 2026-11-16 for the `repo:objectstack#1` seat is 「除了前任的任务继续处理，后续只认领 p1 或者阻塞 p1 的任务」. A survey of the other open p1 and p2 cards found five p2 cards that a customer or a measured environment has run into, with no open upstream block. Their grade is the only thing that keeps the seat from claiming them. Which of them rise to p1?

The three options on the card, as he read them:

- 「按价值挑五张升 p1」: 「#34228 中文打印、#34332 金额大写、#34095 升级预览漏字段、#34038 新组织示例数据无负责人、#33824 AI 问数露内部名,排在现有 p1 之后做。」 (recommended)
- 「只升中文打印两张」: 「只放开 #34228 和 #34332,中文报价单、合同能正常打印出去。其余三张留在 p2,本席不能认领。」
- 「先不加」: 「本席先做完手上 9 张和待领 3 张 p1。这五张继续留在 p2,没有席位可以认领。」

## The ruling

**#34228, #34332, #34095, #34038 and #33824 are raised to p1 and may be claimed. They are taken after the p1 work already in hand, not ahead of it.**

Why this card was one of the five, as told to him: A printed record page in a zh-CN organization shows dates as `11月 15, '26` and lets a wide line-items table run off the page. It was measured on 18.5.0 with a downstream quote print page (the blackcat CRM project), so a customer-facing document is what breaks.

The p2 on this card is triage's first-touch grade. This is his own later word on the card and sets the grade.

## State

- This record changes no label. The grade write (`priority:p2` to `priority:p1`) is for the seat that takes the ruling, with this record as its Ruling-ref.
- Size was estimated from the card face only and was not measured.
- Survey: `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/objectstack/value-survey-2026-11-16.md`.
- Knock: `Notify: ruling` to the `repo:objectstack#1` mailbox, PR #34367, and to the triage mailbox, PR #32588.

Thread-read: 6922168481 (the dev report, newest comment at the read; five comments in all).

## The question he was asked

Item 3 of this card. `print.avoidBreakInside` is published as "keep each block whole on one sheet when it fits" (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`, the key's describe), and the print stylesheet does exactly that (`[data-region] > * { break-inside: avoid; }` in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page-print.ts`). On the quote, the last block holds two sections (pricing and terms, about 472 pt on a 740 pt printable sheet), so with 3 lines it moves whole to sheet 2 and sheet 1 is 35% blank (dev measurement, PR #34422).

The three options on the card, as he read them:

- 「C 规则不动,拆开报价单模板」: 「报价单里「价格和条款」由一块写成两块,三行明细时第一页留白约从35%降到4%。其他打印件不变,文档补一句写法说明。」 (recommended)
- 「A 规则不动,不处理」: 「这一项按「符合设计」结案。三行明细的报价单第一页仍空约三分之一,其他打印件不变。」
- 「B 改规则,按小节分页」: 「平台以后允许一块内容在小节之间分页。报价单同样降到约4%,但所有现有打印件不改就变,例如发票的两个小节可能分到两页。」

## The ruling

**The published meaning of `avoidBreakInside` does not change: the block stays the unit that is kept whole. A print page that should be allowed to break between sections authors one `record:details` block per section. `Metadata-protocol: none`.**

Why, as told to him: the paper result on the quote is the same as changing the rule, no published meaning moves, and no other print page changes. The same fix is already merged for the HotCRM contract document (hotcrm#2410, `src/sales/pages/contract_print.page.ts`: "One block per group, not one block of three … measured: three pages, now two").

## What follows (the seat executes; no further ask is owed for these)

1. **Premise first.** The area's dev splits the last block into two one-section blocks in the same harness and measures sheet 1 at 3 and 6 lines. Expected: about 4% blank at 3 lines and about 18% at 6 lines, the readings PR #34422 reports for the per-section rule. ⛔ If the 3-line reading is clearly worse than that (above 10%), stop and come back to the decision thread. Do not build option B on your own.
2. The seat answers the reporter here: item 3's outcome, the authoring recipe (one section per block), the measured numbers, and the HotCRM contract page as the example. The downstream project edits its own template.
3. The seat files a hotcrm card: `quote_print_page`'s `quote_print_totals` block (`sections: [{ group: 'pricing' }, { group: 'terms' }]`, `src/revenue/pages/quote_print.page.ts`, read at hotcrm `32c08e2`) becomes two blocks. It takes this card's priority and goes to the hotcrm lane.
4. One wording PR on the platform: `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx` and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` each gain one sentence saying that `avoidBreakInside` works per block, and that content which may break between sections is authored as one `record:details` per section. The showcase invoice is not changed.
5. PR #34422 lands as it is (L1 and review as usual). This card closes when steps 2 to 4 are done.
6. The seat files a separate card for a finding that is NOT part of this ruling: with the key on, a `record:line_items` table that does not fit the rest of sheet 1 moves whole to sheet 2, and sheet 1 keeps only the customer block. Measured only on a simplified page (plain HTML and Chromium, not the real print-page DOM): 26, 28, 31 and 36 lines all start the table on sheet 2; at 26, 28 and 31 lines that is one sheet more than with the key off. A template cannot fix it, because a table is one block. The card first measures the real page (from how many lines, how much blank). If a fix needs the published meaning to change, that is a new decision.

## State

- This record changes no label and no spec text.
- Readings: the 35% / 4% / 18% figures are the dev's, from PR #34422. "Split blocks paginate the same as a per-section rule" is the decision thread's probe on a simplified page, identical sheet by sheet at 3, 6, 15, 22, 26, 28, 31 and 36 lines. The split on the real quote page is unverified until step 1.
- The downstream template (steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm) was not read. That it has the HotCRM quote page's shape is inferred from this card's description.
- Analysis: `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/review/34228-decision-analysis.md`. Probe: `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/review/34228-pagination-probe.mjs`.
- The card body is the reporter's own and is not edited; this comment is the record.

Ruling-ref: 6922479414 (maintainer 「C 规则不动,拆开报价单模板」).

**The platform rule does not change.** `print.avoidBreakInside` keeps each *block* whole on one sheet when it fits. Your quote's last `record:details` block holds two sections, about 472 pt on a 740 pt printable A4 sheet, so with a short quote the whole block moves to sheet 2.

**The authoring fix is on your side: one section per block.** Where a print page may break between sections, write one `record:details` block per section instead of one block that holds several. For example:

```ts
{ type: 'record:details', id: 'quote_print_pricing', properties: { sections: [{ group: 'pricing' }] } },
{ type: 'record:details', id: 'quote_print_terms',   properties: { sections: [{ group: 'terms' }] } },
```

The HotCRM contract print page already does this: hotcrm#2410, `src/sales/pages/contract_print.page.ts`, three sheets became two.

**Measured on the real quote page** (A4 portrait, zh-CN; dev report 6923091449), sheet 1 blank:

| Line items | One block | One section per block |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 35% | 4% |
| 6 | 18% | 18% |

At 6 lines the pricing section, about 200 pt, does not fit the roughly 131 pt left on sheet 1, so it starts sheet 2 whole, as intended.
